    "evidence": "Upon termination of this Agreement, the Vendor shall archive all operational data",

  },

    "clause_id": "k5",
    "rule_id": "R06",

  },
  {
    "clause_id": "k6",
    "rule_id": "R07",
    "verdict": "compliant",
    "confidence": 0.95,
    "evidence": "the Vendor shall notify the Client within twenty-four hours of discovery",
    "reason": "The processor is required to notify the controller promptly well within the 72-hour regulatory timeframe."
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "k6",
    "rule_id": "R09",
    "verdict": "compliant",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "evidence": "the Vendor shall notify the Client within twenty-four hours of discovery",
    "reason": "The clause establishes proper incident notification channels between processor and controller."
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "k7",
    "rule_id": "R07",
    "verdict": "compliant",
    "confidence": 0.95,
    "evidence": "Either party may terminate this Agreement immediately upon written notice if the other party material breaches",
    "reason": "This clause deals with contract termination for material breach and does not concern data breach notifications."
  }
